name: Clarity
description: Ability to articulate thoughts clearly without convolution.
evidence_markers: avoids excessive jargon when not needed
maintains a logical progression of ideas

name: Relevance
description: Ability to stay on topic and answer the specific question asked.
evidence_markers: connects examples back to the main point

name: Structure
description: Ability to organize an answer logically (e.g., STAR method).
evidence_markers: has a clear beginning, middle, and end

name: Interaction
description: Ability to engage naturally in a conversational format.

name: Explanation
description: Ability to explain complex concepts to varied audiences.

name: Fluency
description: Ability to speak smoothly without excessive pauses or filler words.

name: Pronunciation
description: Ability to pronounce words clearly and understandably.

name: Grammar
description: Ability to use correct grammatical structures.

name: Vocabulary
description: Ability to use a wide and appropriate range of words.

name: Sentence Structure
description: Ability to construct simple, compound, and complex sentences.

name: Confidence / Delivery
description: Ability to project confidence through vocal tone and demeanor.

name: Eye Contact
description: Ability to maintain appropriate eye contact with the camera/interviewer.
evidence_markers: looks directly into the camera frequently
avoids looking down or away for extended periods

name: Posture
description: Ability to maintain a professional physical presence.

name: Pace
description: Ability to speak at an appropriate and understandable speed.
evidence_markers: maintains a generally controlled speaking pace

name: Engagement
description: Ability to visually and vocally engage the listener.

name: Problem Solving
description: Ability to identify a problem and reason through solutions.

name: Reasoning
description: Ability to logically deduce conclusions from premises.

name: Critical Thinking
description: Ability to objectively analyze and evaluate an issue.

name: Decision Making
description: Ability to make firm choices and justify them.
evidence_markers: explains the criteria used for the decision

name: Behavioral Response
description: Ability to answer past-experience behavioral questions effectively.
evidence_markers: focuses on own actions rather than team actions

name: Professionalism
description: Ability to maintain a professional demeanor and tone.
evidence_markers: does not speak negatively of past employers

name: Teamwork
description: Ability to collaborate effectively with others.

name: Leadership
description: Ability to guide, mentor, or lead initiatives.

name: Adaptability
description: Ability to adjust to new conditions or changes.
evidence_markers: explains how they learned a new skill quickly

name: Technical Knowledge
description: Demonstrates awareness and understanding of technical concepts.
evidence_markers: lists appropriate tools for a task

name: Technical Accuracy
description: Provides factually correct technical information.

name: Technical Depth
description: Demonstrates deep, low-level understanding of a technical area.
evidence_markers: explains underlying mechanics (e.g. memory, network layers)

name: Technical Explanation
description: Ability to explain technical implementation and reasoning.
evidence_markers: explains why a particular approach was chosen
